cards.name: Proud Parent
cards.oracle_text: Commander creature spells you cast gain offspring 2 as you cast them. Tokens created this way aren't legendary. (You may pay an additional 2 generic mana as you cast a commander creature spell. If you do, when that creature enters, create a 1/1 token copy of it.)

cards.name: The Charitable Kids
cards.oracle_text:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, you may gift a nonland card you own from outside the game to an opponent. If you do, they may cast it without paying its mana cost. (The gift's recipiant owns that card. For real. Forever. Unless they regift it, I guess.)
Whenever you give a gift, you draw a card, gain 2 life, and put two +1/+1 counters on The Charitable Kids.

cards.name: The Countess of Counterspells
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever you cast a permanent spell, you may counter it. If you do, create a token that's a copy of it, except the token is a Nail artifact. (The token isn't any of the spell's other types.)
{U}{U}: Counter target spell. Activate this ability only if you control ten or more Nails.

cards.name: The Rhystic Friends
cards.oracle_text:
When The Rhystic Friends enter, each player creates a Rhystic Study token. (C'mon, you know what it does.)
Whenever a player doesn't pay the 1, put a +1/+1 counter on The Rhystic Friends (This will trigger for any optional cost of {1}, not only Rhystic Study.)

cards.name: The No Mana Bard
cards.oracle_text:
If a player would create a Treasure token, instead an opponent of your choice loses 2 life.
Whenever The No Mana Bard attacks, you may pay {5}{R}{G}. If you do, you may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.

cards.name: Throw Shade
cards.oracle_text: Create a 1/1 black and red Shade creature token with haste and "{B}: This token gets +1/+1 until end of turn." At the beginning of your next end step, scrifice that token. When you do, it deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.

cards.name: Red Smothering Tithe
cards.oracle_text: Whenever an opponent draws a card, that player may have this enchantment deal 2 damage to them. If the player doesn't, you create a Treasure token.

card_faces.name: Strixhaven Film Student
card_faces.oracle_text: Whenever a legendary creature you control deals combat damage to a player, Strixhaven Film Student becomes prepared.

card_faces.name: Cut
card_faces.oracle_text: Cut deals 4 damage to target creature.

cards.name: Raccoon
cards.oracle_text: You may forage during your turn. (To forage, exile three cards from your graveyard or sacrifice a Food. You can do this as many times as you want. There's no benefit, really, but this l'il guy sure appreciates it. He'd probably like it if you drew him, too.)

cards.name: The Lorwyn Lizard
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever you cast a creature spell with a Lorwyn creature type you don't already control, draw a card. (The Lorwyn creature types are Elemental, Elf, Faerie, Giant, Goblin, Kithkin, Merfolk, and Treefolk.)
{T}: Add X mana of any one color, where X is the number of different Lorwyn creature types among creatures you control without changeling. If you control all eight, add an additional {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.

cards.name: The Urza Finder
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever The Urza Finder enters or attacks, choose a random Eternal-legal nonland card with the word "Urza" in its name. You may cast a copy of it without paying its mana cost. (Many Magic search engines have random card features. Some even have "random card from search" buttons.)
The Urza Finder gets +1/+1 for each different card name with "Urza" in it from among permanents you control. ("Urza's" counts.)

cards.name: Ms. Bumbleflower, No Longer Kind
cards.oracle_text:
Menace
When Ms. Bumbleflower enters, you become the head chef. (It's like the monarch but you create a Food token rather than draw a card.)
Whenever you cast a spell, each opponent blights 1. The blighted creature loses flying until end of turn. If this is the second spell you've cast this turn and you're the head chef, each opponent gets a poison counter.

cards.name: The Queen of Wolves
cards.oracle_text:
Other Wolves and Werewolves you control get +1/+1.
Whenever The Queen of Wolves attacks, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of a random Wolf creature card (Many Magic search engines have random card features. Some even have "random card from search" buttons.)
Partner—King and Queen (You can have two commanders if they both have this ability.)

cards.name: The Gaming Explainer
cards.oracle_text:
+1: Draw a card. Add two mana of any one color. Spend this mana only to cast spells or activate abilities that have reminder text. (This is reminder text.)
−3: For each player, return up to one target nonland permanent that player controls without reminder text to its owners hand.
−7: Exile the top seven cards of your library. Cast any number of spells from among them with reminder text without paying their mana costs.
The Gaming Explainer can be your commander.

cards.name: Shroomsday, Feast Spoiler
cards.oracle_text:
Shroomsday gets +X/+X, where X is the number of poison counters among players.
At the beginning of each player's upkeep, they create a Food token with vanishing 2 and "When the last time counter is removed from this Food, you lose 3 life and get two poison counters." (They can still eat it before it goes bad.)

cards.name: The Radioactive Gravymaker
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever The Radioactive Gravymaker enters or attacks, for each player, put a gravy counter on up to one target nonland permanent that player controls. Then proliferate.
Whenever a permanent with a gravy counter on it dies, its controller gets a rad counter for each gravy counter it had on it. (Yeah, we have to double check how rad works too.)

cards.name: The Sabertooth Wizard
cards.oracle_text:
Each legendary creature you control gets +1/+1 for each legendary creature you control whose name begins with "The."
Whenever The Sabertooth Wizard attacks, mill cards equal to its power. Then choose a creature or planeswalker card in your graveyard whose name begins with "The." You may pay {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}. If you do, return it to the battlefield. If you don't, return it to your hand. If you can't choose a creature card this way, create a Treasure token.

cards.name: The Tale of Jimothy
cards.oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
The Tale of Jimothy can be your commander. If it is, Jimothy is also your commander.
I — Create Jimothy, a legendary 2/1 green Raccoon with "Whenever a card is put into your graveyard from your library, put a +1/+1 counter on Jimothy."
II, III — Surveil 1.

cards.name: The Kinnan Hirer
cards.oracle_text:
Flying, vigilance
Whenever The Kinnan Hirer enters or deals combat damage to a player, create a Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy token, except it's not legendary.
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
{5}{G}{U}: Activate the 5GU ability of each creature named Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy you control.

cards.name: The King of Grixis
cards.oracle_text:
Attacking creatures you control have deathtouch.
Whenever one or more other creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, sacrifice one of them. You may cast a Grixis spell from your hand without paying its mana cost. If you don't, choose a random Grixis card and create a copy of it. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. (A Grixis spell is exactly blue, black, and red.)
Partner—King and Queen (You can have two commanders if they both have this ability)

cards.name: Critter, Behind the Camera
cards.oracle_text:
When Critter enters, ereate an Equipment token named Camera with "Whenever equipped creature attacks, surveil 1" and equip {1}. Attach it to Critter.
Whenever an equipped creature you control deals combat damage to a player, exile target card from that player's graveyard with a recording counter on it.
{T}, Sacrifice an Equipment: You may cast a card from exile with a recording counter on it without paying its mana cost.

cards.name: Gigi Wellplayed
cards.oracle_text:
({Z} is rainbow mana, one mana from any source that could add two or more colors of mana. This card is all colors.)
At the beginning of combat on your tumn, flip a coin until you lose a flip.
Whenever a player wins a coin flip, create a Treasure token.

cards.name: The Alien Spellslayer
cards.oracle_text:
({Z} is rainbow mana, one mana from any source that could add two or more colors of mana. This card is all colors.)
Whenever The Alien Spellslayer enters or attacks, put a transformation counter on up to one target non-Alien creature. It becomes an Alien that's all colors.
Whenever an Alien you control attacks, it can't be blocked this combat.

cards.name: The Roaming Guild Pack
cards.oracle_text:
The Roaming Guild Pack is all colors.
Whenever you cast a spell that's exactly two colors, you may join that Ravnican guild. If you leave another guild this way, put two +1/+1 counters on The Roaming Guild Pack.
At the beginning of your upkeep you gain 2 life if you're in a white guild. Draw a card if you're in a blue guild. Each opponent loses 2 life if you're in a black guild. Create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token if you're in a red guild. You may play an additional land this turn if you're in a green guild.

cards.name: The Sayer of Don't
cards.oracle_text:
({Z} is rainbow mana, one mana from any source that could add two or more colors of mana. This card is all colors.)
Whenever you cast a spell, if rainbow mana was spent to cast it, put a don't counter on The Sayer of Don't.
Remove two counters from The Sayer of Don't: Counter target spell.

cards.name: The Stylish Spellslayer
cards.oracle_text:
({Z} is rainbow mana, one mana from any source that could add two or more colors of mana. This card is all colors.)
Each other creature you control gets +1/+1 for each differently named counter on it plus another +1/+1 for each color it is.
{1}{Z}: Put a style counter on target creature.

cards.name: Ham Sandwich
cards.oracle_text:
{T}: Add one mana of any color. This artifact deals 1 damage to each opponent. You may remove a counter from a permanent you control.
Whenever you untap another non-Food permanent outside of your untap step, mill one or more cards, or one or more creatures you control enter, untap this artifact.
{2}{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain 3 life.

cards.name: The Mystery Booster
cards.oracle_text:
Rulebreaker companion — A deck with this commander or companion can have ONLY cards from any Mystery Booster set and playtest cards of any color identity, as well as any basic land cards.
Whenever The Mystery Booster attacks, look at the top fifteen cards of your library. You may cast a Mystery Booster or playtest spell from among them without paying its mana cost. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.

cards.name: The Wondrous Architect
cards.oracle_text:
If The Wondrous Architect is your commander, your deck may have any number of cards named Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, and Urza's Tower. For each one that isn't in your deck, you may choose a basic land card to become that card before the game begins. (For example, each Mountain in your deck is an Urza's Mine and each Forest is an Urza's Tower.)
Whenever The Wonderous Architect enters or attacks, create a token that's a copy of one of the following, chosen at random: Dark Sphere, Aladdin's Lamp, Jayemdae Tome, Chaos Orb, Time Vault, or Sol Ring.

cards.name: The Bird Pool
cards.oracle_text:
(This land isn't a spell, but still costs {1}{U} to play. It has summoning sickness and has "{T}: Add {U}.")
Flying
Whenever you tap The Bird Pool for mana, if you have seven or more cards in hand, draw a card.
{U}{U}{U}, {T}: Counter target spell. Its controller draws three cards.
